<!-- ============ WHAT NOBODY TOLD YOU ============ -->
<section class="band" style="background:#FBF6EC;">
<div class="wrap">
<div class="eyebrow">Here's what nobody told you</div>
<h2 style="font-size:32px; margin-bottom:28px; color:#2E5E4E !important;">It was never just about “picky eating”.</h2>
<div class="point"><div class="mark" style="background:#C8643B;">1</div><div><h4>Allergens hide in “safe” foods</h4>
<p>Pap, custard, Milo, stock cubes, baking powder, soy sauce, many “gluten-free” products — gluten, corn, dairy and sugar hide in foods we eat every day. You can't avoid what you can't see.</p></div></div>
<div class="point"><div class="mark" style="background:#6FA37A;">2</div><div><h4>A calmer gut can mean a calmer child</h4>
<p>Many parents notice that when the gut is irritated, everything feels harder — sleep, moods, toilet troubles and picky eating. Removing the irritants and adding healing foods is where many families start.</p></div></div>
<div class="point"><div class="mark" style="background:#E3A12F;">3</div><div><h4>Picky eating is often about feeling safe</h4>
<p>A child who eats only a few foods is often a child whose senses feel overwhelmed. Pressure makes it worse. Gentle steps, familiar foods and fun shapes make it better.</p></div></div>
<figure class="pic"><!-- PICTURE 2: day page (drawn in code, no upload needed) -->
<div class="dp"><div class="dp-top"><div><small>WEEK 1</small>Day 2</div><em>Today's habit: 10 minutes of bouncing or dancing.</em></div><div class="dp-r"><div class="dp-rh" style="background:#FBEFD3;"><span style="background:#E3A12F;">Breakfast</span><b>Blueberry Banana Breakfast Cookies</b><i>25 min</i></div><div class="dp-rb"><ul class="dp-ing"><li>3 ripe bananas, mashed</li><li>2 cups gluten-free oats</li><li>¾ cup blueberries</li><li>Pumpkin seeds, cinnamon</li></ul><ol class="dp-st"><li>Mash bananas with a flax egg.</li><li>Stir in oats &amp; blueberries.</li><li>Scoop onto a lined tray.</li><li>Bake 15–18 min until golden.</li></ol></div></div><div class="dp-r"><div class="dp-rh" style="background:#F8E3D6;"><span style="background:#C8643B;">Lunch</span><b>Chicken Burrito Bowl</b><i>35 min</i></div><div class="dp-rb"><ul class="dp-ing"><li>2 cups rice</li><li>600 g chicken thighs</li><li>1 tin black beans</li><li>2 avocados, salsa</li></ul><ol class="dp-st"><li>Cook the rice.</li><li>Bake spiced chicken 25 min.</li><li>Warm the beans.</li><li>Build your bowls.</li></ol></div></div><div class="dp-r"><div class="dp-rh" style="background:#E4EFE3;"><span style="background:#2E5E4E;">Dinner</span><b>Coriander Pepper Fish &amp; Green Plantain</b><i>35 min</i></div><div class="dp-rb"><ul class="dp-ing"><li>4 small mackerel or tilapia</li><li>3 green plantains</li><li>Fresh coriander, garlic</li><li>Lemon, olive oil</li></ul><ol class="dp-st"><li>Blend a coriander paste.</li><li>Rub over the fish.</li><li>Bake 20–25 min (no foil).</li><li>Serve with boiled plantain.</li></ol></div></div></div><figcaption>Every day planned: breakfast, lunch and dinner with tick-box ingredients</figcaption></figure>
<p>Put those together and you get exactly what you're living through. Not a parenting problem — a <b>plan problem</b>. And that's exactly what the Healing Collection gives you.</p>

<!-- ============ WHY IT EXISTS (STORY) ============ -->
<section class="band" style="background:#E4EFE3;">
<div class="wrap">
<div class="eyebrow">Why this collection exists</div>
<h2 style="font-size:30px; margin-bottom:20px; color:#2E5E4E !important;">I have stood in that kitchen too.</h2>
<p>I'm Tris — an autism mum. I know the child who eats only three foods. The sleepless nights. The quiet ache when the words haven't come yet. The prayers whispered over a sleeping child.</p>
<p>When I changed what went on my child's plate — taking out gluten, dairy, corn, eggs and processed sugar, cooking real food from scratch, and adding one gentle detox drink a day — things began to change. Slowly at first. Then I saw a <b>real, significant improvement in my child</b>.</p>
<p>I couldn't keep these recipes to myself. So I put everything into one simple collection: no long science, no fancy ingredients you can't find. Just real food — jollof, yam, plantain, pasta, pancakes, nuggets — made safe for your family, one day at a time.</p>
<p><b>It's not a promise that every child will respond the same way. It's a plan built around real families, real kitchens and real children — like yours.</b></p>
</div>
</section>
